name: core-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the user-scope baseline — the plugins worth enabling once, globally, and keeping on in every repo: secret-scanning's write-time block, candor's five-clause Stop gate and dormant terse mode, code-review's fan-in review with comment discipline, git-workflow's branch finish, hindsight's friction mining, skill-router's file-aware routing, and stack-scan's report, audit and project-tier scout. Replaces always-on-suite and quality-suite (2026-09-14). Membership rule: project-agnostic, safe as a permanent fixture, adds no interruption you did not ask for — why command-guard's ask tier is not here. Uninstall with /core-suite:uninstall. 200k windows: read the README first.
